HappyBedrock - a Bedrock minigame network

Join on play.happybedrock.org (port 19132) from any Bedrock device, Minecraft 1.20 to 26.60.

Games

- Bed Wars, SkyWars, The Bridge, Duels, Murder Mystery, Survival Games, Annihilation, Conquests, Meltdown, Momma Says, Soccer and Pillars of Fortune

- Wizard Wars: our own magic battle royale with 30 spells, wands, summons and Team Deathmatch

- TNT Wars

- SkyBlock (Agora and Skyland) and Factions (Badlands and Farlands)

Why play here

- Network levels, cosmetics, pets and ranked play with seasons

- Vote every day for the Voter rank, credits and crate keys

- Store ranks are cosmetic and quality-of-life perks only
